title: CS_SANDBOX_ENGINE selects the engine and appears in no document
foundBy: session agent, while comparing the CS_SANDBOX_* variables in the code against the ones in the docs

evidence.verified: `grep -rn CS_SANDBOX_ENGINE *.md` returned nothing before and now returns MANUAL.md's Environment table, second group, with the podman default the flag parser applies.

details:
`internal/cli/create.go:65` defaults the `--engine` flag from `CS_SANDBOX_ENGINE`. Grepping the markdown for that name returns nothing, in MANUAL.md or anywhere else.

So a user on a Linux host with KVM who wants Podman has to pass `--engine podman` on every create. The alternative is reading the source to learn that one export would do it. The variable is the closest thing the tool has to a user-level engine default, and it is invisible.

MANUAL.md is where a flag's meaning lives, by the table in CONTRIBUTING.md, so the entry belongs beside `--engine` there.

notes.text: The closing evidence said the Environment table carries "the podman default the flag parser applies". The parser applies no default: internal/cli/create.go reads envOr with an empty fallback, and the effective engine is firecracker on Linux with KVM. SBX-017 updates the table.
